verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page (sketch-docs-14 to 18, 26, 27, 39) shows AI-assisted features like dark-mode conversion, color palettes from photos, lorem-ipsum replacement, and an MCP server letting AI clients 'recreate text styles, colors, UI components, and even entire pages inside Sketch' from a repo. This implies some prompt-driven design generation via connected AI clients, but the documented use cases are repo-to-design or frame-to-code conversions, not a direct 'type a prompt, get a first draft/mockup' generation flow inside Sketch itself, and no hands-on examples or independent corroboration of prompt-based mockup generation exist. Missing for 10: first-party in-app text-to-mockup generation flow, concrete example outputs from prompts, and independent/hands-on verification that natural-language prompts reliably produce usable layouts.
